sessionFailures: a second exchange resolved despite maxSessions=1
two exchanges crossing an awaited public-key lookup both resolved despite maxSessions=1

invariants: default capacity is 10000 and an optional positive safe-integer maxSessions can lower it
active sessions plus exchanges in flight never exceed capacity across asynchronous verification
capacity exhaustion is a controlled retryable 429 SESSION_CAPACITY response
expired and non-finite records are purged globally at exchange and authenticate entry
capacity never evicts a live session
